meta.description: Convert slide images, screenshots, scanned PDFs, and image-only PPT/PPTX files into high-fidelity object-level editable PowerPoint, including semantic-region mixed reconstruction, measured flowcharts and knowledge graphs, native circle nodes and connectors, single-object thin and filled arrows, speaker-note preservation, and rendered QA. Requires Python 3.10+ with deterministic CLI-driven workflow.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive conversion workflow: semantic-region decomposition, measured flowcharts/knowledge graphs, native shapes (circles, connectors), single-object arrows (thin/filled), speaker-note preservation, rendered QA. Handles slides, screenshots, scanned PDFs, image-only PPTX. Minor: no explicit video/animation recovery mentioned.

reliability.note: Excellent quality gates: formula rendering hard gate, visual-review-evidence with hash-bound checks, page validation before record, final deck revalidation, arrow atomicity verification. Single source of truth enforced (page_jobs.json, manifest.json, deck_manifest.json). Minor: no automatic rollback on finalize failure.

performance_context.note: Efficient parallel page dispatch up to capacity in page_jobs.json. Progressive reference loading (workflow.md always, others on-demand). Minor: no guidance for very large decks (100+ slides) or memory-constrained environments.

agent_usability.note: Clear deterministic CLI workflow. Authoritative file ownership map excellent. Single entrypoint enforced (cli/image2ppt/cli.py). Page-worker prompt generation separate. Minor: complex lifecycle (prepare → next → dispatch → build → record → finalize) could benefit from state machine diagram. No discovery of other skills enforced but reason unclear.

human_usability.note: Comprehensive contracts (workflow.md, page-decision-tree.md, manifest-schema.md, qa-contract.md). Bilingual triggers (图片转可编辑PPT). Minor: steep learning curve with 13 references, complex page lifecycle, required visual-review-evidence template completion. Limited examples for first-time users.

security.note: Excellent boundary enforcement: page build writes only inside page directory, no traversal/absolute escapes/symlinks allowed. Image backend selection provider-neutral with explicit provenance recording. Optional Baidu AI Studio token for OCR with offline fallback. No credential exposure in manifests.

maintainability.note: Excellent single-source-of-truth principle: authoritative files clearly defined, forbidden parallel state explicitly listed. Schema version 2 for manifests. Ownership map clear. Pre-migration behavior preservation documented. Minor: lacks version migration guide for schema_version 1→2 upgrade.

agent_specific.note: Strong deterministic workflow with CLI-driven lifecycle. Hash-bound visual-review-evidence prevents stale checks. Region decomposition evidence in manifest. Image backend abstraction (builtin-imagegen vs CLI contract). Minor: worker prompt generation separate but lacks explicit context-size management guidance. No discovery of other skills rule seems overly restrictive for potential integrations (e.g., nature-figure for diagrams).

key_strengths: Excellent single-source-of-truth principle: authoritative files clearly defined (page_jobs.json, manifest.json, deck_manifest.json), forbidden parallel state explicitly listed
Strong boundary enforcement: page writes only inside page directory, no traversal/absolute escapes/symlinks, prevents accidental file corruption
Robust quality gates: formula rendering hard gate, hash-bound visual-review-evidence prevents stale checks, arrow atomicity verification, final deck revalidation
Sophisticated reconstruction: semantic-region decomposition with independent routing, measured compound diagrams native (not flattened), single-object arrows
Clean deterministic workflow: CLI-driven lifecycle with explicit state files, parallel page dispatch, provenance tracking for image backend

recommendations.title: Add state machine diagram for page lifecycle
recommendations.problem: Complex page lifecycle (prepare → next → dispatch → build → QA → record → finalize) with multiple states (pending, claimed, building, failed, recorded) documented textually but lacks visual state machine diagram showing transitions and terminal states.
recommendations.root_cause: Workflow.md describes sequence linearly. State transitions implicit in CLI commands. New users struggle to understand valid state transitions and recovery paths.
recommendations.fix: Add references/page-lifecycle-state-machine.md with: (1) state diagram showing all valid transitions, (2) terminal states (recorded_success, failed_permanent), (3) recovery paths (reset → dispatch for failed pages), (4) invalid transitions explicitly marked. Include in workflow.md 'Always read' section.

recommendations.title: Add timeout and zombie worker detection
recommendations.problem: Parallel page dispatch can have workers that hang indefinitely (network issues, infinite loops, resource exhaustion). No explicit timeout or zombie detection mechanism documented. 'Do not reset a live worker merely because it is slow' leaves ambiguity on when reset is justified.
recommendations.root_cause: Dispatch lease in page_jobs.json lacks timeout field. No monitoring for worker health beyond manual inspection.
recommendations.fix: Add dispatch_timeout_seconds to page_jobs.json (default 1800s for complex pages). Add 'run check-workers <run>' command that: (1) checks dispatch timestamp, (2) flags zombies exceeding timeout, (3) provides reset recommendation with reason. Update workflow step 3 with: 'Run check-workers periodically for long-running decks. Reset zombies only after timeout confirmed.'

recommendations.title: Add schema version migration guide
recommendations.problem: Manifest schema version 2 required for new pages, but no documented migration path for existing schema_version 1 manifests. Users with old runs cannot upgrade without manual rewrite.
recommendations.root_cause: Schema evolution mentioned (schema_version: 2) but breaking changes from v1→v2 not documented. No migration script provided.
recommendations.fix: Add references/schema-migration.md documenting: (1) v1 vs v2 differences (structured visual_inventory with kind/representation, explicit quality_evidence), (2) migration script scripts/migrate_manifest_v1_to_v2.py that upgrades fields and adds required quality_evidence placeholders, (3) validation that upgraded manifest builds correctly. Include 'not backward compatible' warning.
